items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I sat in with Johnny Wicks and Raymond Burke.

ctx.x: Well, he had that time and that feeling and that touch. If you don't have that you've just lost everything. It's so amazing that anybody could play that simple and get so much music out of it. He just had so much inside of him I guess it comes out. Since you've been in New Orleans, well what happened when you came to New Orleans? I'll put it that way. You came alone?

Yeah, I hitchhiked from here, from Chicago. I came here in the morning and I saw Jeffy. I went down to Preservation Island and I saw him. I think it was a Saturday because that guitar player was playing like that. What is his name? Babe Stovall. Yeah, he was playing. I knowed him through a radio program from what I learned before. So I went in there and I was there. They had a jam session after that, which I also was with and I played a few songs. I sat in with Johnny Wicks and Raymond Burke. And since then…
Was that the time when Bob Green was here?
